name: nextcloud-aio
description: Nextcloud All-in-One - WARNING, SPECIAL CASE: the compose stack only contains the AIO master container. The actual Nextcloud/DB/Redis containers and their volumes (nextcloud_aio_*) are created by the master OUTSIDE this compose project - docker-backup CANNOT see them, so this stack backup does NOT contain your Nextcloud data. Use AIO's BUILT-IN borg backup (AIO interface -> Backup) for the data. What THIS backup captures and why it still matters: compose.yml and the mastercontainer volume with AIO's configuration.json - including the borg encryption password (key escrow!). db_autodetect is off; the doctor warning 'NO database will be captured' is correct and stays as a reminder.
